release_note: Baseline for the deterministic fidelity gate (ADR-0017): the compression-OFF run of the golden session IS the baseline — its governance outcomes are the recorded `expected` values in golden-session/manifest.json, and the OFF outbound-token total is the reduction denominator. The gate (FidelityGate) requires the compression-ON run to reproduce this baseline exactly (zero divergence) plus 30-95% token reduction. Re-verified live each run; not a stored numeric snapshot.
